depends_on: generalized Bernoulli B_{1,chi} for imprimitive characters
notes: -A166406(n)/N = B_{1,chi} for chi = J(.,N), N = 2n+1 = N' m^2: integer except when N' = 3 and all primes p != 3 dividing m are 2 mod 3, where it is -2^w/3; A166100(n)/N = phi(N)/4 + B/2 is an integer whenever B is (parity via h(-N') and genus theory). So A166101 = {n : 2n+1 = 3m^2, primes of m other than 3 are 2 mod 3} and the conjecture holds. Outside Lean: all steps (class number formula, genus theory); certificate/check.py checks n <= 6000 against b-files, check_a166101.py matches all 92 A166101 b-file terms.

sources.cite: L. C. Washington, Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields, Ch. 4
sources.what: B_{1,chi}, imprimitive characters, class number formula

prior_art.note: Classical tools; the application and the explicit description of A166101 are ours.
